title: Records whose releases changed lately
description: data/changes.json: every record whose releases, or gone mark, changed from since on, and records added or removed, by the path it is read at, with when the lists saw it. A launcher that read a record at or after since, and finds it here with no later time, has it as it is now and need not ask; one that read it before since asks, as this file cannot tell. Counts, scans and the readme change without a record being listed. Fields may be added at any time.

since.description: From when this file lists every change: a week before generated, or when the lists began tracking changes if later

generated.description: When the lists wrote this file, which is the time each change listed in it was seen at or before

records.description: A record's path, such as mods/owner/repo.json, to when its releases last changed; a removed record's path too, which now answers 404
